# 🎯 Top-Performing Facebook Ad Headlines for Your Flooring Business

## **URGENCY & OFFER-DRIVEN**
1. "Transform Your Home in 48 Hours – 30% Off All Hardwood This Week Only!"
2. "Your Dream Floors Start at $3.99/sq ft – Before They're Gone!"
3. "Stop Hiding Your Ugly Floors! Free Estimate + Same-Week Installation"

## **PROBLEM-SOLUTION FOCUSED**
4. "Tired of Floors That Look Cheap? See Our $2,500 Living Room Makeover"
5. "Pet-Proof, Kid-Proof, Life-Proof Flooring That Actually Lasts"
6. "Cold Tile Making You Miserable? Warm Up to Luxury Vinyl in 1 Day"

## **SOCIAL PROOF & TRUST**
7. "Why 847 Local Homeowners Chose Us for Their Floor Transformation"
8. "5-Star Rated Flooring | 200+ Before & Afters | See Why Neighbors Are Talking"
9. "From Disaster to Dream Floor – See This Week's Incredible Makeovers"

## **ASPIRATIONAL & LIFESTYLE**
10. "Turn Your House Into a Home You're Proud to Show Off"
11. "The Floors You Pin on Pinterest, Installed in Your Home This Month"
12. "Barefoot-Worthy Floors That Make Every Morning Feel Luxurious"

## **DIRECT & NO-NONSENSE**
13. "Quality Flooring. Fair Prices. Zero Runaround. Request Quote →"
14. "New Floors Installed Next Week | Click for Instant Quote"

**💡 Pro Tip:** Test 3-4 headlines with the same image, then double down on the winner!

Which style resonates most with your brand voice?
